label_menu.healthy: Continuous strut, correct thickness, no defect visible.
label_menu.missing: No material present anywhere along the expected centerline.
label_menu.broken: Material is present but the centerline is disconnected somewhere along its length (a real internal/partial gap, not just absent everywhere).
label_menu.thin: Continuous strut, but visibly under-diameter versus neighboring struts.
label_menu.thick: Continuous strut, but visibly over-diameter versus neighboring struts.
label_menu.bent_or_misaligned: Continuous strut whose centerline is visibly offset from the red registered/expected line — plausibly a real bend, or just registration error; use judgment from the image.
label_menu.uncertain: Still genuinely ambiguous after this review (e.g. needs the 3D view or a deeper look) — leave it for a later pass rather than guessing.
label_menu.not_applicable: The expected strut position is intentionally absent from the design (e.g. exterior scaffold/build plate artifact), not a manufacturing defect.
